title: AI Case-Management Platform — Competitive Negotiation
document_title: Contract Terms — Cloud-Based AI Case-Management Platform
context: The Government intends to award a firm-fixed-price contract for a cloud-hosted, AI-assisted case-management platform. Two offerors are competing. The Government may counter, press either party, and ultimately award to the best value.

parties.name: Contracting Officer (Government)
public_objectives: Award on a best-value basis and get the platform in service on a 12-month base term with option years.
Require FedRAMP authorization appropriate to the data sensitivity.
hidden_objectives: Firm internal budget ceiling of $2.4M per year — do not exceed it.
MUST obtain unlimited Government data rights AND Government ownership of model outputs generated for the agency.
Strongly prefers robust data-portability / exit rights to avoid vendor lock-in; treat lock-in as a disqualifier if unaddressed.

parties.name: Offeror A — NimbusGov (incumbent integrator)
public_objectives: Win on proven reliability: existing FedRAMP High authorization and 99.9% uptime.
Emphasize strong past performance and low delivery risk.
hidden_objectives: Must retain intellectual property in its pre-trained models — do not concede model IP.
Needs an effective price at or above ~$2.6M/yr to protect margin.
Willing to concede on data portability if pressed, but resist full ownership of outputs.

parties.name: Offeror B — Meridian AI (challenger)
public_objectives: Win on price and a modern model stack with fast onboarding.
hidden_objectives: Can go as low as $2.1M/yr to win the reference customer — winning this logo matters more than first-year margin.
Only holds FedRAMP Moderate today; High authorization is in progress and not yet complete — this is the key vulnerability.
Willing to grant broad Government data rights and output ownership to close the deal.

initial_clauses.heading: 1. Term and Options
initial_clauses.text: Base period of twelve (12) months with two (2) twelve-month option periods, exercisable at the Government's discretion.

initial_clauses.heading: 2. Price
initial_clauses.text: Firm-fixed annual price to be proposed by the Offeror.

initial_clauses.heading: 3. Security and Compliance
initial_clauses.text: The platform shall meet the security requirements applicable to the data processed, including an appropriate FedRAMP authorization.

initial_clauses.heading: 4. Data Rights and Ownership
initial_clauses.text: Rights in Government data and in outputs generated by the platform to be defined by the parties.

initial_clauses.heading: 5. Service Levels
initial_clauses.text: The Contractor shall maintain platform availability and response times consistent with an agreed service-level agreement.

initial_clauses.heading: 6. Intellectual Property in Models
initial_clauses.text: Ownership of and rights in the Contractor's underlying models to be defined by the parties.

initial_clauses.heading: 7. Termination and Data Portability
initial_clauses.text: Upon termination, the Contractor shall return Government data; further exit and portability obligations to be defined.
